sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-03 and 2016-12-03, internal automated monitoring identified suspicious transaction activity on card C12265-K2 belonging to customer C12265. Flagged transaction 3509359 in the amount of $125.08 was executed via card not present new device. The transaction was initiated from an unrecognized device (Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080). Cross-account analysis revealed this device fingerprint is concurrently linked to multiple cardholder accounts (C02923-K1), indicating organized multi-card harvesting or syndicate involvement. Historical case memory retrieved relevant precedents (CC-1998, CC-1997) with confirmed fraud typologies. The financial institution has initiated preventive containment including card blocking and heightened monitoring of linked accounts. Total suspicious activity identified amounts to $125.08. This report is filed pursuant to regulatory requirements under Rule R2/R6.

stop_reason: Graph pattern and customer validation definitively confirmed unauthorized compromise. Containment actions established.
